name: Pegboard Climb
description: A climbing movement using wooden pegs inserted into a vertical board where the athlete progresses hand over hand upward. This builds extraordinary grip strength, upper body pulling power, and shoulder stability. A staple of gymnastics strength testing and specialty functional fitness.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Pegboard Climb in proper strongman position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare all equipment and body position for Pegboard Climb.
steps: Step 1: Grip two pegs at the bottom of the pegboard at shoulder height.
Step 2: Pull body up and insert upper peg into the next hole above.
Step 3: Continue alternating peg placements up the board.
Step 4: Descend with the same alternating pattern under control.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace core maximally before every lift. Breathe between reps if needed.
common_mistakes: Not fully locking arm on each reach
safety_considerations: Use collars on all loaded barbells.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion specific to the implement being used.
coaching_cues: Descent is as important as ascent
